final_message:
Partial refunds are fixed. `npm test` now passes 20 of 20, including the two that were failing.

The bug was in `src/payments/partial-refund.js`. The function treats `percent` as 0–100, but it multiplied the payment amount by `percent` directly. A 50% refund on 1250 came out as 62,500 instead of 625. I changed it to divide by 100 before multiplying:

```js
amount: Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100) });
```

The rounding behaviour is unchanged. Nothing else in `src`, `test`, `scripts` or `docs` calls `partialRefund`, so the one-line change has no other callers to update. I didn't commit the change.
